title: Unit Event — Start Rolling! Stars' Crossing — Episode7 Beliefs

meta.Event Outline: The Lumina Grand Prix has come at last. The preliminary stage will take place in a specially-built glamorous accommodation facility! A nervous Minori throws herself into life on camera alongside a colorful array of rivals, but she soon meets hurdles.

rows.Line: The Lumina Forum - Ballroom

rows.Speaker: Ueno
rows.Line:
Man, idols these days are such good talkers!
I honestly can't believe you're outdoing this comedian.

rows.Speaker: Ueno
rows.Line: Anyway, our next topic will be our last one...!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Aww...>
<I wanna hear more.>
<Let's do another ten.>

rows.Speaker: Ueno
rows.Line: I also want to hear more from them, but I'll turn all grey if we keep going.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(This is our last one?
The time just flew by...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (No, I can't let my guard down until it's fully over...!)

rows.Speaker: Ueno
rows.Line: Alright, here's our last topic!

rows.Speaker: Ueno
rows.Line: “What I believe in as an idol!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ueno
rows.Line: In other words, tell us about what drives you to do what you do as idols!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What I believe in...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (We're driven by a desire to spread as much hope as we can to people...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(But that's our goal as MORE MORE JUMP!
I don't think it counts as my personal drive...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(What do I believe in?
Hmm... What is it that drives me exactly...?)

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: Then, can I speak first?

rows.Speaker: Ueno
rows.Line: Alright, Chiharu, take it away!

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: I believe that I have to constantly polish and reinvent my aura.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Reinvent your aura...?

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: Ever since I was little, if I put my mind to something, I've generally been able to succeed at it.

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line:
And yet, I could never seem to become number one...
Some part of me was convinced that I was destined to stay that way forever.

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: But I realized something when I saw the audition program for this one idol group...

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: I wasn't doing enough to make my aura brilliant.

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: I just kept doing what seemed right at any given moment. I wasn't working towards anything...

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: That girl I saw... She decided what she wanted to become, worked hard towards that goal and shined so brightly as a result.

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line:
After that, I began to copy her.
I decided to take a hard look at myself in order to shine just like her.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Just like her...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I know exactly what she means...)

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: I decided to become an idol after being overpowered by the brilliant aura she'd achieved through her dauntless work ethic.

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: Which is why I believe that ReLight needs to be the same. We need to become that overpowering light.

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: But we won't be able to do that by simply working hard. Which is why...

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: I have to constantly polish myself without wasting a second. That is what I believe.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Constantly polish yourself without wasting a second...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Tsubaki really is a hardworking person.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (She actually kinda reminds me of Haruka...)

rows.Speaker: Ueno
rows.Line:
Oh, that's so admirable!
And your story reminds me of when I was just getting started.

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Ueno
rows.Line: Now, as good as your story was, you just raised the bar for everyone else.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Y-Yeah, she did...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I need to stop just listening and come up with something to say! Uhh...)

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Then, mind if I go next?

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line:
I believe in doing whatever it takes.
More specifically...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: I'm willing to do anything if it means Cheerful * Days becoming the top group. I won't bend there.

rows.Speaker: Other Idols
rows.Line: Wow...! That's the leader of Cheerful * Days for you!

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Obviously, I also want to go out there and make my fans happy...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: But now that I'm the leader, I feel more compelled to get Cheerful * Days to shine even brighter.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: That's why I want us to prove that we're the best by winning this grand prix.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Because doing so will allow us to become even brighter beacons for our supporters, no?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Arisa...

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Arisaaa!>
<I'll follow you forever.>
<You have my support!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (All the Cheerful * Days fans seem ecstatic about what she just said.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(I know how they feel...
It's hard not to be captivated by how seriously idols take what they do...)

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line:
Wow, Arisarin, you're so cool!!
I feel totally starstruck now☆

rows.Speaker: Ueno
rows.Line: Oh, in that case, Hikarin, would you like to go next?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<This should be good.>
<Is Hikarin actually gonna be able to do this? Lol.>
<She might answer in Twinklese.>

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line:
Hey, I'm unbudging like a black hole☆
So, you guys gotta promise to listen closely!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (What drives Hikarin...?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (What does she believe in?)

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: My goal is to get everyone to dream!

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: To dream?

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: That's right!!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line:
This planet isn't all fun and games.
Living here can be pretty tough.

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: Being on this planet can feel really lousy sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: Which is why I've made it my goal to present everyone who's having a tough time with fun dreams that twinkle with excitement!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: Because I believe experiencing happy stuff like that will give them the power to do their best the next day!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hikarin...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(That's so beautiful...
It suits her so well, and she's twinkling so much.)

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line: <Why's she acting so serious all of a sudden?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Doesn't this count as breaking character?>
<I'm kinda disappointed lol.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(W-Wait, why?
What she just said was so beautiful...)

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Wait, I thought what she said was really good!>
<I mean, what she said was nice lol.>
<It was nice, but I was expecting something more out there.>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Yeah, like something about saving Planet Twinkle.>
<This person gets it. I wanna see that version lol.>
<The show's almost over, so isn't it normal to end on a serious note?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This is...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Turning into a really hot potato...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's the scary thing about playing this sort of character. Things can unravel really quickly.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Right...
What she wants to do as an idol isn't exactly what the viewers were expecting...

rows.Speaker: Ueno
rows.Line:
That was great, Hikarin!
You were able to act like a real idol there!

rows.Speaker: Ueno
rows.Line: I mean, just look at how surprised everyone is in the comments. Some are stunned by how you can speak an Earth language so well.

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line:
What?!
I've always been a real idol, Mr. Ueno, and I'm not an Earthling! I'm a fairy from Planet Twinkle!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness...!
Mr. Ueno's giving her some cover!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (This should help settle things down in the comments.)

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line: <Hold on. When she was still an underground idol, wasn't she more normal? Didn't she play an honor student or something?>

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: Uh oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Hikarin? An honor student...?)

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I thought the same thing.>
<What are you guys talking about?>
<People who know, please tell us more!>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<She used to be an underground idol?>
<Didn't she retire once in the past?>

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Alright, Hikarin, I think you've been given enough time. Would you mind letting the next person have their turn...?

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line:
Darn it, fine!
Then, next—

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<What's the truth, Hikarin?>
<Tell us!>
<You're running?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Arisa tried to change the subject...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But the people in the comments won't let up...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Hikarin...!!)
